# Bucksworth Home Services

> Family-owned Arizona pest control, termite, and weed & lawn care company serving 35 cities across the Phoenix and Tucson metro areas since 2013. We also offer air conditioning, heating, plumbing, and water heater service in the Phoenix metro. AZ ROC #343924. AZ Department of Agriculture License #9613. Google Guaranteed.

Bucksworth Home Services is a residential home services company founded in 2013 by Jordan and Taylor Moore. Our primary services are Pest & Termite control and Weed & Lawn Care, offered in all 35 cities we serve. Air Conditioning & Heating and Plumbing & Water Heaters are offered in our 26 Phoenix-metro cities only.
